finite_counts: Role strings on alphabet {S,B,C,X0} with at least one C and at least one X0: 4^7 - 3^7 - 3^7 + 2^7 = 12138.
The maximum number of set partitions of seven selected C positions is Bell(7)=877.
Exhaustive enumeration of 2^16 Boolean tables with downward-closed good-mask family gives exactly 168 monotone four-color message tables.
For all 168 tables the inclusion-minimal bad masks form an antichain of size at most 6, matching Sperner on a four-element ground set.
The seven concrete vertices have exactly C(7,2)=21 pair-adjacency bits.
extraction_map: Given any actual tuple, canonical seed indexing turns every source neighborhood tau(B)=N(B) cap S into an s-bit mask and preserves all relations among source types.
chi_S, L_P, chi_X0 and A(B) are deterministic finite-mask data.
Each selected residual vertex has an actual connected-component identity; canonical first-occurrence relabeling yields a finite partition label without changing same/different-component facts.
C0 assigns every coupled residual component a monotone message table from the 168-type language and a unique MIN_BAD antichain certificate.

Restricting D_C to the finitely many participating B positions preserves every dynamic-component adjacency relevant to the seven-role tuple; source axiom (iv)+connectedness guarantees consistency across multiple selected representatives of the same component.

Every selected X0 identity has one of four colors and a six-bit local adjacency profile; additional booleans can record whether that fixed color was already excluded by seed/another same-color X0 identity.
The complete 21-bit induced graph records every path/chord observation on the seven identities exactly.
pruning_soundness: If two selected C vertices are from different residual connected components, their pair is a forced nonedge by definition.
If two selected C vertices are from the same component, every dynamic B has identical adjacency to them by axiom (iv)+connectedness.
Same-colored adjacent already-fixed S/S, X0/X0, or S/X0 pairs are inconsistent with proper precoloring.
If a selected X0_c is adjacent to a selected B or C representative, color c must occur in that target's declared X0 color mask.
independent_replay.cover_logic: No converse is needed. The grammar is a finite over-approximation: every actual tuple is mapped by direct extraction to one locally consistent cell. Extra unrealizable cells cannot falsify coverage.
independent_replay.finiteness: For fixed s, every coordinate of the cell belongs to a finite domain: seed types <=2^s, four-color masks <=16, component partitions <=877, message types <=168, local profiles are finite bit vectors, and graph adjacency has 21 bits. Hence the cell space is finite.
nonclaims: No polynomial bound in original input size is derived from finiteness.
No generated cell is asserted source-realizable unless separately witnessed.
No representation distinction is asserted extension-relevant without exact downstream adequacy.
